Description: You found the self-hosted website of your neighbor and noticed that it is a crypto wallet. Use basic web knowledge to get access to their wallet.
Hint1: You can use web tools to view the HTML source code.
Hint2: Web tools provide a function to inspect the web storage.
Hint3: The web storage function allows you to see the content of all saved cookies.

Description: You are on a news webpage but want to access information that is not easily available through the search function.
Hint1: You can do something special with the search function.
Hint2: Maybe the website uses a database in the backend. Did the developer secure it properly?

Description: This is a new website created by some students from HTL Mössingerstraße. Use a tool to find a hidden file. The file contains some information about crypto; take a good look.
Hint1: The student provides more on their website than you might think.
Hint2: There may be hidden files; try changing the URL.
Hint3: You can use FUZZ to find hidden files.

Description: This is a new website created by some students from HTL Mössingerstraße. Use a tool to find a hidden file. The file contains some information about crypto; take a good look. Some other information might help you assemble the flag.
Hint1: The student provides more on their website than you might think.
Hint2: There may be hidden files; try changing the URL.
Hint3: The student manipulated the IDs. Another number may provide additional information.

Description: A hacker displays a photo of himself on his page. Find some special information.
Hint1: You might take a closer look at the image.
Hint2: Have you tried using EXIF tools already?
Hint3: You can use a web tool to view the metadata.

Description: You have a special project. Maybe you can figure out what this file does.
Hint1: The script is written in Brainfuck.
Hint3: The script is broken. Try to fix it on your own :).

Description: In this challenge, you were tasked to find the flag within a picture. Good luck!

Your mission is to uncover the first flag hidden within information related to Tanja Alina Weiss. Somewhere in the details provided, a flag is subtly concealed. The flag could appear in unexpected places, so stay sharp!
Identify the destination that Tanja considers her most favorite place she has visited so far.
Uncover her birthday. The answer may require careful deduction and attention to detail. Submit your findings in the format FF{DD-MM-YYYY}.

The time traveler’s first clue is hidden in plain sight on their old blog. The blog was hosted at www.faketimemachine.rf.gd, but it has since vanished. Use your time machine (hint: archive.org) to recover their lost notes and find the first piece of the time capsule.
Hint1: Your time machine is named archive.org ...

Description: Great work, traveler! You’ve found the first piece of the time capsule. But the next clue is more subtle. The second flag is hidden deeper within the echoes of the blog—inspect it carefully.
Hint1: Maybe you can find some images, that aren't that easy to access.
Hint2: Have a look at the hidden directories.

Description: You’re almost there! The third and final piece of the time capsule requires your problem-solving skills.
Hint1: There should be other files than the images.

ChallengeName: Git Secrets: Layers of Discovery - Part 1
Description: The infamous PhantomCoder0916 has been hiding encrypted messages in their Git repository, PhantomCode. Your mission is to track down and uncover these secrets before they disappear forever. Each clue brings you closer to understanding what PhantomCoder0916 is up to. A strange commit appeared in the PhantomCode repository. Rumors say it contains a secret message, but it's buried among countless fake commits. Can you find what PhantomCoder0916 was trying to communicate?
Hint1: Search commit messages carefully—one of them hides the truth.

ChallengeName: Git Secrets: Layers of Discovery - Part 2
Description: A crucial file once existed in the repository but was mysteriously deleted. What was in it? Why did PhantomCoder0916 erase it? Your task is to retrieve what was lost before it's gone for good.
Hint1: Look through the commit history to find traces of the missing file.

ChallengeName: Git Secrets: Layers of Discovery - Part 3
Description: Not all secrets are erased—some are cleverly hidden in plain sight. PhantomCoder0916 has been marking important milestones in the repository, but one of these marks conceals something unusual. Can you find the hidden message?
Hint1: Examine the tags carefully. One of them contains a secret.

ChallengeName: Git Secrets: Layers of Discovery - Part 4
Description: Someone has been tampering with the repository—an unknown user who shouldn’t have access. But who is it? PhantomCoder0916 may have created a fake identity to cover their tracks. Find the imposter and expose their email address to uncover the final piece of the puzzle. Submit your findings in the format FF{email-address}
Hint1: Investigate the commit authors. One of them doesn’t belong.

Description: You stumbled upon a flyer… but is the organization behind it hiding something?
Hint1: Could the flyer be hiding something more?
Hint2: What if the first flag holds the key to the second?
Hint3: Run east, and you just might stumble upon a hidden boss.

Description: We have found an endpoint that prints some strange data. According to some captured documentation this endpoint contains the password of a administrative account. As always, the password is in the format FF{somelongstring}
Hint1: Maybe the data is not in a human readable format.
Hint2: Characters can be represented in binary.
Hint3: Maybe it is not just one whole string as output, but two

Description: Prof. Schmidt’s coordinates to his favourite holiday destination were stolen. Unfortunately, he separated them into three pieces (due to security policies) which makes finding them quite difficult. However, the thief left some hints about their locations. Now it's your turn to find them! (The student's favourite eating location; This place is quite interesting, but sadly, experiments are rather rare; 'Das ist aber SCHADE!'
Hint1: Both are rather easy if you know what you have to do...
Hint2: SYT: URI model | Maths: Length of an unknown side is needed
Hint3: SYT: First R, then I | Maths: Sinus and cosine rule may help

Description: Our security experts gathered an invoice during an investigation. It is believed that there is hidden information in the mentioned document - can you find it?
Hint2: Do you really think you have inspected the document completely?

Description: Our security experts gathered an invoice during an investigation. It is believed that there is hidden information in the mentioned document - can you find it?
Hint1: Honestly, what do you expect of a PDF?
Hint2: Do you really think you have inspected the document completely?
Hint3: Is this the only file you downloaded?
